% Canonical conditioning and claim-boundary statements shared by both views.
\providecommand{\SCIMapConditionalityStatement}{%
All linear expectation, fixed-state response, and complete numerical
covariance statements are conditional on fixed membership, projection,
coefficients, support policy, response state, geometry/WCS, calibration, and
upstream processing state. A MAP-local realized operator response is always
disclosed for a valid MAP product. Upstream-conditioned fixed-state, PTC
full-procedure, and PTC+MAP re-resolved responses retain their separate
availability and limitations. Numerical full-procedure subtraction additionally
requires the complete authorized comparison-space record; a state difference
alone does not establish subtractability. A whole-chain RTC-to-CAL-to-PTC-to-MAP response
is unavailable unless separately established by an authorized complete study
and is not claimed here.}
\providecommand{\SCIMapClaimBoundaryStatement}{%
Algebraic contract correctness, engineering conformance,
representation/response fidelity, observational performance, and production
readiness are separate claims.}
\providecommand{\SCIMapQuantityStatement}{%
The ordinary signal is a calibrated-\(x\)-derived nonpolarimetric
total-intensity-equivalent detector-time quantity. Neither a unit token nor a
legacy STOKES field promotes it to Stokes~I.}

\providecommand{\SCIMapLifecycleAssumption}{%
Resolution, application, and realization are distinct. Pre-application
validation examines the exact
\texttt{observation\_\allowbreak{}resolved} parameter and
profile state. Application binds that resolved state to one attempt. A later
realized record binds what that attempt actually produced; it cannot be used
retroactively as the prerequisite that authorized the attempt.}
